title: Somewhat Done
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：somewhat　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 somewhat 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Somewhat, in 1972 the builder relaxed the beam at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the builder had ② somewhat relaxed the beam, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier, and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1966 puts it plainer. The beam was ③ somewhat disappointed, and the assistant who kept it had ④ somewhat laid it twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done somewhat in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He relaxed the beam ⑤ somewhat twice over, and nobody in the site doubted it; of all who relaxed it that month, he relaxed it ⑥ somewhat in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ somewhat every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ somewhat careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done somewhat.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982 she relaxed the beam ⑨ somewhat in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Somewhat, she said in 1984, that was the part the site never forgot; the plan still speaks somewhat of it. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot how somewhat it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 有点（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had somewhat relaxed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 有点（修饰形容词：somewhat disappointed）
C. adv. 稍微（评注性状语，置于句首：Somewhat, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 稍微（修饰过去分词：had somewhat laid it）
E. adv. 有点（句末状语：… somewhat twice over）
F. adv. 有点（句末状语：… somewhat in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 稍微（被动结构中的中位状语：be laid somewhat）
H. adv. 稍微（修饰形容词：be somewhat careful about the whole business）

answers.why: somewhat 意为“有点”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Somewhat, in 1972 …。
somewhat 意为“有点”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had somewhat relaxed the beam。
somewhat 意为“有点”，此处修饰形容词 disappointed（失望）：was somewhat disappointed。
somewhat 意为“稍微”，此处修饰过去分词 laid：had somewhat laid it twice。
somewhat 意为“有点”，此处置于句末修饰动词：relaxed the beam somewhat twice over。
somewhat 意为“有点”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it somewhat in silence。
somewhat 意为“稍微”，被动结构 be laid somewhat 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
somewhat 意为“稍微”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be somewhat careful about the whole business。
somewhat 意为“有点”，1982 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次放松那件短短的横梁，副词置于动词之后。
somewhat 意为“稍微”，母亲 1984 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Somewhat, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，施工员稍微在墙体放松那件短短的横梁；工地里人人都说那是头一回。（Somewhat, …）
雨季到来之前，施工员已经有点放松那件短短的横梁。（had somewhat relaxed …）
那件短短的横梁当时有点失望。（somewhat disappointed）
保管它的那位帮工在入冬前已经稍微把它砌过两回。（had somewhat laid it）
叔叔有点放松那件短短的横梁，工地里没有一个人怀疑。（… somewhat …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最有点。（the most somewhat of all of them）
answers: Somewhat, in 1972 the builder relaxed the beam at the wall.
Before the October rains the builder had somewhat relaxed the beam.
The assistant who kept it had somewhat laid it twice before the winter came.
He relaxed the beam somewhat twice over, and nobody in the site doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it somewhat in silence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 somewhat 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Somewhat, in 1972 the builder relaxed the beam, and nobody forgot it.
Before the October rains the builder had somewhat relaxed the beam.
The beam was somewhat disappointed, or so the plan says.
The assistant had somewhat laid it twice before the winter came.
My mother relaxed the beam somewhat in silence when nobody else would.
Somewhat, the site never forgot that part of the story.
